pull_request.body:
## Summary

Add the trusted repository policy validator.

## Changes

- Validate immutable approval and review receipts.

## Impact

- User/runtime: repository policy failures become visible before merge
- API/schema/dependencies: adds the repository policy contract
- Operations/deployment: no production deployment
- Not changed: pull request heads remain untrusted input

## Verification

- Conformance fixtures — local runner — passed
- Unverified: none

## Risk and rollback

Risk: high — changes repository policy enforcement

Rollback: revert the pull request

## Related

Fixes #42
Plan: .ops/plans/42-policy-validator.md

issue_body:
## Problem

Repository approvals are not machine-validated.

## Desired outcome

Trusted validation rejects stale or malformed evidence.

## Work

- Add trusted contract validation.

## Acceptance

- Stale and malformed evidence is rejected by conformance fixtures.

## Non-goals

- Executing untrusted pull request code.

## Context

High-risk repository policy change governed by issue #42.
